# Valmera video editing agent

> Valmera edits recordings you supply. In Studio or a supported assistant, select your project, describe the edit, review a rendered preview and export the approved version as an MP4.

## Inspect an exported recording

- [Watch a recorded video editing agent revision](https://valmera.io/examples/rough-cut-revision). Codex used Valmera MCP to shorten the middle shot. The page links both versions at six seconds, the source and the editable handoff.

- [Find a source phrase in two edited files](https://valmera.io/blog/check-video-editor-export#compare-speech). The same 720 ms excerpt occurs at different times after two manual sentence cuts and keeps its original time under an MCP picture cutaway. [Reproduce the checks directly from the MP4s](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/FREE-EXPORT-CHECK.md#locate-the-surviving-speech-after-a-cut).

## Try an edit

- [Turn photos and music into an MP4](https://valmera.io/tools/ai-slideshow-maker#photo-sequence). Arrange photos in a free browser editor and check two exports of the same six-second sequence. An eligible Studio account can take the sequence as an AI editing brief.

- [Hand a client an MP4 or editable picture cut](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/VIDEO-EDITING-AGENTS.md#what-files-can-i-hand-to-a-client): Studio and MCP render a finished MP4. The separate single-source rough-cut builder creates Shotcut MLT and CMX files. Reopen the three-shot example to test which parts remain editable.

- [Test an AI video editor on the same two clips](https://valmera.io/ai-video-editor#test-an-ai-video-editor): Download a narration, product cutaway and shared brief. Compare a local export against four measured reference frames and check voice continuity. [Reproduce the measurements](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/TOOLS.md#compare-exports-from-different-ai-video-editors).
- [Compare actual edits](https://valmera.io/examples): Switch between source and edit at the same moment. At 1.60 seconds in the caption example, inspect the corrected word. At 2.80 seconds in the B-roll example, compare the pictures and listen to the voice across the cut.
- [Recorded MCP edit and final file](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/MCP-RECORDED-EDIT.md): A silent three-shot fixture, a two-second revision to the middle shot, tool arguments, previews and the downloaded MP4. The final file includes branding and an end card.
- [Evaluate a video editor](https://valmera.io/ai-video-editor-pricing-comparison): Use the same source and one revision to compare an editor's preview, downloaded result and cost. Account creation and uploads are free in Valmera. Hosted AI editing requires eligible paid access. See [current plans](https://valmera.io/subscribe).

## Find a workflow

- [Fix one timed word and download SRT or WebVTT](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/CAPTION-REVISIONS.md#convert-word-level-timestamps-to-subtitle-files): Open a four-second recording and its 12 source-word records, change cue six from “and” to “Um,” and compare the downloadable subtitle files. The free browser converter also accepts your own word-timed JSON and matching media.

- [Compare AI clippers for a four-hour webinar](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/WEBINARS.md#which-ai-clipper-can-use-a-four-hour-webinar): Worked 8 GB example for OpusClip, Kapwing and Valmera with source size, processing duration, credit units and caption timing for an answer at 03:20:00.

- [Edit a long webinar](https://valmera.io/tools/long-video-upload-checker): Check upload size and indexed duration, then map a passage from the original recording to an excerpt. A passage at 03:20:00 in a four-hour source starts at 00:20:00 in a section beginning at 03:00:00. Download the section's time map and rebased captions. The [worked webinar example](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/WEBINARS.md#find-an-answer-after-hour-three) includes both timing fixtures.
- [Price a season of AI-generated clips](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/PODCAST-CLIP-WORKSHEET.md#price-one-season-of-clips): Compare actual annual bills, source-minute and generated-clip allowances, and measured Valmera credit usage for your own episodes.
- [Edit two interviews into one timeline](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/INTERVIEW-PAPER-EDIT.md#hand-off-the-two-speaker-cut-as-an-editable-timeline): Relink two speakers on picture and dialogue tracks, revise the ending, and check captions against the frame-aligned edit.
- [Turn an interview into shorts](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/PODCAST-CLIPS.md): Select a complete exchange, preserve the speaker's meaning, and review each short's crop and captions.
- [Correct subtitle drift](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/SUBTITLE-SYNC-EXAMPLE.md): Use two known cue times to correct scale and offset. Check a third cue independently.
- [Hand a rough cut to a human editor](https://valmera.io/blog/ai-rough-cut-to-editable-timeline): Open a single-source picture cut in Shotcut or download a CMX edit list with the original media.
- [More editing workflows](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/README.md): Browse guides for tutorials, real estate, courses, YouTube and other recording types.

## Connect an assistant

- [Client setup](https://valmera.io/mcp/setup): The editing server uses Streamable HTTP at https://valmera.io/mcp/server and requires authentication. Select the project that owns the recording and discover the tools available in that session.
- [Claude plugin](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/CLAUDE-PLUGIN.md), [ChatGPT](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/CHATGPT.md), [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/GEMINI-VIDEO-EDITING.md) and [Grok](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/GROK.md): Check the specific client and account requirements before connecting or handing off a brief.
- [Video editing tool reference](https://github.com/ABO3SKRALMASAOODI/valmera-mcp/blob/main/docs/TOOLS.md): For an approved final export, call export_final on the reviewed version, follow its job and retrieve the final download URL.
